description: This file defines the LogNode interface used for logging purposes within an Android project. It specifies a method for outputting log data, supporting chainable logging nodes.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface representing a logging node capable of outputting log information and possibly forwarding it to other nodes in a chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Defines a method for logging data, including priority level, tag, message, and an optional Throwable for exceptions.
